subject.title: fix(ui): make session history accessible in picker and sidebar

question: Should this PR remain the canonical combined fix for accessible Control UI session history, or be narrowed to the derived-title/sidebar accessibility slice while rename controls continue in sibling PRs?
rationale: The current diff no longer matches the older combined rename-control proof/body, and overlapping open PRs still cover narrower rename/title slices; automation cannot choose the final UX sequencing for maintainers.

options.title: Narrow and repair this PR
options.body: Treat this branch as the derived-title and sidebar-accessibility slice, fix the patch-refresh hydration bug, and require exact-head proof for that final scope.

options.title: Restore the combined scope
options.body: Ask the contributor to restore or rebase current-head picker/sidebar rename controls and prove the full VoiceOver-friendly history workflow here.

options.title: Pause for sibling sequencing
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers choose among the open derived-title, picker-rename, and sidebar-rename candidates.

recommendation.title: Narrow and repair this PR
recommendation.body: Treat this branch as the derived-title and sidebar-accessibility slice, fix the patch-refresh hydration bug, and require exact-head proof for that final scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Control UI/sidebar work and earlier chat session controls ownership make this the best available routing signal for the scope decision.
